title: Super Pointy Sprint Missile - 0 to Mach 10 in 15 Seconds - 100Gs & 6000°F
summary: A short video on the US Sprint anti-ballistic missile, which accelerated to around Mach 10 in seconds under extreme g-forces and heat. It includes striking launch footage and a brief development history.
why: Shared in hypersonic and missile threads as a compact, impressive overview of what Sprint achieved in the 1960s.

quote.text: It's a great overview of the development of the Sprint though, worth watching if it's of interest.
